title: A diary you go over together
description: The client keeps the entries, and with their consent the specialist sees the period that matters and leaves comments.

blocks.text: A specialist has their own way of working with clients’ diaries. What matters is not only the detailed composition of the foods but also being able to open the entries you need before a discussion.

quote.text: I’m a registered dietitian and I have a proaccount and use it to help my clients with calorie counting and food tracking and I appreciate that it gives me all the macronutrients and micronutrients

blocks.text: Give access to a chosen period

The client chooses who sees which entries. The specialist sees the same period and can leave a comment on a particular day. If needed, the client closes the access or hands over a one-off selection instead of a standing view.
Start from the joint work that already exists

Find out what the specialist receives now: screenshots, a spreadsheet or messages. It makes sense to replace exactly that repeated work; extra figures without a convenient way to exchange them may turn out to be superfluous.
